# ZUI — React 19 Component Library (AI Quick Reference)

> ZUI is a token-driven, zero-runtime-style, accessibility-first React 19 component library.
> This file is the LLM-facing cheat sheet: read it fully and you can generate correct ZUI code.

## Install & Setup

Version 0.4.0 is distributed through GitHub Packages, not npmjs. Configure
@yeyouyuan:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com in the project .npmrc and log in
with a GitHub account that has package read access. Install aliases below keep
source imports at @zui/*.

This release includes OfficeEditor and OfficeStudio. OfficeEditor requires a
separately deployed ONLYOFFICE Docs service and backend configuration. OfficeStudio
uses ZUI controls and independent document models with host file codecs, printing
and persistence; it does not require an Office server. The published Registry has
73 components and 16 blocks.

```
pnpm add @zui/react@npm:@yeyouyuan/zui-react@0.4.0          # components + bundled styles
pnpm add @zui/tokens@npm:@yeyouyuan/zui-tokens@0.4.0         # optional: TS constants + CSS variable references
pnpm add @zui/blocks@npm:@yeyouyuan/zui-blocks@0.4.0         # optional: 16 page-level business blocks
```

```tsx
import '@zui/react/styles.css'; // once per app (includes tokens + reset + all component styles)
import { Button, Input, Select, Modal, Tabs, Table, MessageProvider, useMessage } from '@zui/react';
```

- React 19 native refs: components accept `ref` directly via `React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'x'>`. NEVER use `forwardRef`.
- Theme: default follows system. Force dark with `document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'dark'`, force light with `'light'`, clear the attribute to follow the system again.
- Controlled convention (ALL stateful components): `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange` (or `checked` / `defaultChecked` / `onChange` for boolean state; `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange` for Modal).
- Sizes: `size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'` default `'md'` (Switch: `'sm' | 'md'`; Table uses `density`; Message has no size).
- `disabled?: boolean` everywhere. Every component forwards remaining props to its root element (className, style, aria-*, data-*, events) unless noted.

## Business Blocks

- Package: `@zui/blocks`; docs route: `#/blocks`.
- 16 blocks: Login, Dashboard, TablePage, FormPage, UserCenter, Permission,
  Settings, Wizard, ProfileEdit, OrderList, DataScreen, TimelineFeed, Kanban,
  ErrorPages, SearchResult, ListDetail.
- Import from the package root or a named subpath such as `@zui/blocks/table-page`.
- Blocks use `@zui/react` styles; import `@zui/react/styles.css` once in the app.
- Stateful blocks expose controlled values and callbacks. The docs route provides
  live interactions, reset behavior, and copyable integration examples.

## Component API Signatures (one prop per line)

### Button
```
Button: (props: ButtonProps) => JSX.Element
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'danger'   // default 'primary'
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'                                            // default 'md'
  loading?: boolean                                                    // default false; spinner + aria-busy, blocks click, stays focusable
  iconStart?: React.ReactNode
  iconEnd?: React.ReactNode
  fullWidth?: boolean                                                  // default false
  classNames?: { root?: string; icon?: string; label?: string; spinner?: string }
  ...rest: React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>                       // forwarded to root (except 'prefix')
Root data attrs: data-variant | data-size | data-loading | data-full-width
Parts: root | icon | label | spinner
```

### Input
```
Input: (props: InputProps) => JSX.Element
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'                                            // default 'md'
  status?: 'default' | 'error' | 'success'                             // default 'default' (root data-status)
  prefix?: React.ReactNode
  suffix?: React.ReactNode
  clearable?: boolean                                                  // default false; clear button when value present
  onClear?: () => void
  classNames?: { root?: string; input?: string; prefix?: string; suffix?: string; clear?: string }
  ...rest: React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'input'>                        // forwarded (except 'prefix', 'size')
Structure: root(z-input) > prefix + input(z-input-field) + clear(z-input-clear) + suffix
Clear button: type="button", aria-label="清除", hidden when readOnly; focuses input then calls onClear
Parts: root | input | prefix | suffix | clear

Sub-components (compound, also exported flat):
Input.Textarea: <textarea> with same size/status/clearable; min-height instead of fixed height; vertical resize
Input.Password: type toggles password/text; visibilityToggle?: boolean (default true); toggle button aria-label switches 显示密码/隐藏密码
Input.Search: type="search"; onSearch?: (value) => void fires on button click or Enter (never mid-composition); clearable supported
```

### Checkbox
```
Checkbox: (props: CheckboxProps) => JSX.Element
  checked?: boolean
  defaultChecked?: boolean
  onChange?: (checked: boolean) => void                                // NOTE: boolean arg, not event
  label?: React.ReactNode
  indeterminate?: boolean                                              // DOM input.indeterminate + aria-checked="mixed"
  classNames?: { root?: string; control?: string; label?: string }
  ...rest: React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'input'>                        // except 'type' | 'onChange' | 'checked' | 'defaultChecked' | 'size'
Parts: root | control | label   (native input visually hidden, kept for a11y)
```

### Radio / RadioGroup
```
RadioGroup: (props: RadioGroupProps) => JSX.Element
  value?: string
  defaultValue?: string
  onChange?: (value: string) => void
  name?: string                                                        // injected into child Radios
  disabled?: boolean                                                   // group-level, injected
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'                              // default 'vertical' (role="radiogroup" + aria-orientation)
  children?: React.ReactNode
  className?: string
  classNames?: { root?: string }
Radio: (props: RadioProps) => JSX.Element
  value: string                                                        // REQUIRED
  label?: React.ReactNode
  disabled?: boolean
  classNames?: { root?: string; control?: string; label?: string }
  ...rest: React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'input'>                        // except 'type' | 'onChange' | 'checked' | 'defaultChecked' | 'size'
Without RadioGroup, Radios fall back to native name-based grouping.
Parts (Radio): root | control | label   (visual dot: z-radio-dot)
```

### Switch
```
Switch: (props: SwitchProps) => JSX.Element
  checked?: boolean
  defaultChecked?: boolean
  onChange?: (checked: boolean) => void                                // NOTE: boolean arg
  size?: 'sm' | 'md'                                                   // default 'md' (no lg)
  label?: React.ReactNode
  classNames?: { root?: string; track?: string; thumb?: string; label?: string }
  ...rest: React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>                       // except 'onChange' | 'value' | 'type'
Native button with role="switch", aria-checked; Space/Enter toggle.
Parts: root | track | label (thumb slot: class z-switch-thumb, no data-part)
```

### Select (select-only combobox, WAI-ARIA APG)
```
SelectOption: { value: string; label: React.ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }
Select: (props: SelectProps) => JSX.Element
  options: SelectOption[]                                              // REQUIRED
  value?: string
  defaultValue?: string
  onChange?: (value: string) => void
  placeholder?: string                                                 // default '请选择'
  disabled?: boolean                                                   // default false
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'                                            // default 'md'
  status?: 'default' | 'error' | 'success'                             // default 'default'
  id?: string
  name?: string                                                        // renders hidden input for form submit
  className?: string
  classNames?: { root?: string; trigger?: string; value?: string; listbox?: string; option?: string; empty?: string }
  'aria-label'?: string
  'aria-labelledby'?: string
  'aria-describedby'?: string
Trigger: button with aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant (focus stays on trigger)
List: role="listbox"; options role="option" + aria-selected + aria-disabled
Keyboard: Enter/Space/ArrowDown/ArrowUp open (closed); ArrowUp/ArrowDown move; Home/End first/last; Enter/Space select; Esc close + refocus trigger; Tab closes; first-letter typeahead
Parts: root | trigger | value | listbox | option | empty
```

### Combobox (editable, strict-option autocomplete)
```
ComboboxOption: { value: string; label: React.ReactNode; textValue?: string; keywords?: string[]; disabled?: boolean }
Combobox: (props: ComboboxProps) => JSX.Element
  options: readonly ComboboxOption[]                                  // REQUIRED
  value?: string | null
  defaultValue?: string | null
  onChange?: (value, option, { reason: 'selection' | 'clear' }) => void
  inputValue?: string
  defaultInputValue?: string
  onInputValueChange?: (inputValue, { reason, isComposing }) => void
  onSearch?: (query: string) => void                                  // never fires mid-composition
  open?: boolean
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open, { reason }) => void
  filterOption?: false | ((option, query) => boolean)                 // false for externally filtered results
  loading?: boolean
  clearable?: boolean
  openOnFocus?: boolean
  autoHighlight?: boolean
  readOnly?: boolean
  name?: string                                                       // committed value is serialized by a hidden input
Input keeps DOM focus; popup is a listbox with aria-activedescendant. Typing changes only the draft;
selection or clear changes the committed value. Escape/real blur restores strict committed text.
Parts: root | control | input | clear | toggle | panel | listbox | option | loading | empty | error | status
```

### MultiCombobox (editable, strict-option multi-select)
```
MultiComboboxOption = ComboboxOption                                  // identical shape, interchangeable
MultiCombobox: (props: MultiComboboxProps) => JSX.Element
  options: readonly MultiComboboxOption[]                             // REQUIRED
  value?: string[]                                                    // controlled selected values
  defaultValue?: string[]
  onChange?: (value: string[], { reason: 'selection' | 'remove' | 'backspace' | 'clear' }) => void
  inputValue?/defaultInputValue?/onInputValueChange?/onSearch?        // same async channel as Combobox
  open?/defaultOpen?/onOpenChange?/filterOption?/loading?/clearable?/openOnFocus?/autoHighlight?
  name?: string                                                       // ONE hidden input PER selected value (native multi-value)
Selecting toggles the value, CLEARS the draft and KEEPS the panel open. Backspace at empty input
removes the last tag; Escape closes and clears the draft. listbox has aria-multiselectable="true".
Tag remove buttons are tabIndex={-1} with aria-label="移除 {item}".
Parts: root | control | tag | tag-label | tag-remove | input | clear | toggle | panel | listbox | option | loading | empty | error | status
```

### SideNav (site navigation, disclosure groups, collapsible rail)
```
SideNavLinkItem: { key; label; textValue?; href; icon?; badge?; disabled?; linkProps? }
SideNavGroupItem: { key; label; textValue?; icon?; badge?; disabled?; children: SideNavLinkItem[] }
SideNavSection: { key; label?; items: (SideNavLinkItem | SideNavGroupItem)[] }
SideNav: (props: SideNavProps) => JSX.Element
  sections: readonly SideNavSection[]                                   // REQUIRED
  currentKey?: string | null                                            // controlled, derived from Router location
  onNavigate?: (key, item, event) => void                               // same-context plain clicks only; no preventDefault inside
  expandedKeys?/defaultExpandedKeys?/onExpandedKeysChange?              // details.reason: toggle | current | items-change
  collapsed?/defaultCollapsed?/onCollapsedChange?/collapsible?          // desktop rail mode (default collapsible=true)
  renderLink?: (item, props) => ReactElement                            // Router adapter; must forward ref/ARIA/data-* to a native <a>
Native nav/ul/li/a semantics (no role=menu/tree). Current leaf gets aria-current="page";
parent group only data-current-descendant. Group toggles are disclosure buttons
(aria-expanded + aria-controls). Collapsed rail opens flyouts through a portal that
inherits theme tokens; keyboard open focuses first child, pointer open keeps trigger focus.
disabled leaves render as aria-disabled spans without href.
Parts: root | viewport | section | section-label | list | item | link | group-toggle | group-indicator | icon | label | badge | children | flyout | tooltip | collapse-toggle
```

### Splitter (resizable panes, focusable separators)
```
Splitter: (props: SplitterProps) => JSX.Element
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'                               // default 'horizontal'
  sizes?: number[]                                                      // controlled percentages (length = panel count)
  defaultSizes?: number[]
  onSizesChange?: (sizes, { reason, handleIndex }) => void              // pointer | keyboard | collapse | panels-change
  onResizeEnd?: (actualSizes, details) => void                          // pointerup, cancel, keyup or blur; details includes requestedSizes
  handleProps?: (context) => { disabled?; collapseTarget?; aria-label?; ...nativeProps }
  classNames?: { root?: string; handle?: string; handleIndicator?: string }
Splitter.Panel (config-only child; DOM rendered by Splitter):
  label?/initialSize?/minSize?/maxSize? (percent) / collapsible?/collapsedSize? / collapsed?/defaultCollapsed?/onCollapsedChange?
Handles are auto-generated between panels (role="separator", focusable,
aria-controls both stable panel ids, aria-orientation complementary,
aria-valuemin/max/now = preceding panel's effective paired range). Keyboard:
arrows 1% (visual direction, RTL-aware), PageUp/PageDown 10%, Home/End to bounds;
Enter only toggles handleProps.collapseTarget when that panel is collapsible.
Panel percentages divide the container main axis after fixed handle tracks (C - H).
pointerup commits; Escape, pointercancel and unexpected lostcapture restore the start
snapshot and call onResizeEnd once with cancelled=true. Keyboard commits on keyup/blur.
Collapsed content stays mounted with inert + aria-hidden and returns focus to a handle.
Parts: root | panel | content | handle | handle-indicator
```

### OfficeEditor (embedded ONLYOFFICE native document editor; unreleased source addition)
```
import { OfficeEditor } from '@zui/react';
OfficeEditor: (props: OfficeEditorProps) => JSX.Element
  documentServerUrl: string                                            // REQUIRED, browser-accessible Docs server
  config: OfficeEditorConfig                                           // REQUIRED, backend-issued signed configuration
  height?: number | string                                             // parent needs a height for '100%'
  onSave?/onDownload?: (editor) => void | Promise<void>                  // app persists/downloads the generated result
  events?: Record<string, (event: OfficeEditorEvent) => void>            // combines with config.events
  onReady?: (editor, event) => void
  onStatusChange?: (status: 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error') => void
  onError?: (error: OfficeEditorError) => void
  toolbar?/header?: ReactNode | (context) => ReactNode                  // false hides the outer bar, native UI remains
  fullscreen?/defaultFullscreen?/onFullscreenChange?(value)
  scriptTimeout?/readyTimeout?: number                                 // milliseconds
  scriptNonce?: string                                                 // CSP nonce for the official API script
  rebuildKey?: string | number                                         // save before an explicit rebuild
  ref?: Ref<OfficeEditorHandle>                                        // reload(), getEditor(), setFullscreen(boolean)
Word/Excel/PDF editing is supplied by the external Docs engine. Keep JWT secrets,
file permissions and generated-file persistence on the backend. Token rotation
and event callback reference changes preserve the active instance; document key,
mode and permission changes recreate it. Business callbacks must await durable
save completion. Community has AGPL and branding requirements; closed-source
product/SaaS embedding has an explicit Docs Developer commercial license path.
Parts: root | header | toolbar | title | brand | status | actions | stage | canvas | overlay | error
```

### OfficeStudio (independent Word, Excel and PDF workspace; unreleased source addition)
```
import { OfficeStudio, createOfficeStudioDocument } from '@zui/react';
OfficeStudio: (props: OfficeStudioProps) => JSX.Element
  value?/defaultValue?: OfficeStudioDocument                            // version:1, id, name, kind:'word'|'excel'|'pdf'
  onChange?: (document: OfficeStudioDocument) => void
  source?: Blob                                                        // original file; required for PDF rendering
  pdfRenderer?: StudioPdfRenderer                                      // host worker/assets and point-coordinate transforms
  onSave?/onExport?/onPrint?: (document) => void | Promise<void>         // host durability/file output/print dialog
  onImport?: (file: File) => void | Promise<void>                        // update controlled model after parsing
  onCreate?: (kind: OfficeStudioKind) => void | Promise<void>            // PDF creation supplies source bytes
  onError?: (error: Error) => void
  readOnly?/disabled?: boolean                                         // readOnly retains search, browsing, export and print
  height?: number | string                                             // default 760; parent needs height for 100%
  saveState?: 'saved'|'saving'|'unsaved'|'error'                          // host autosave status
  fullscreen?/defaultFullscreen?/onFullscreenChange?(value)
  ref?: Ref<OfficeStudioHandle>                                        // getDocument(), save(), export(), print(), setFullscreen()
createOfficeStudioDocument(kind='word'): OfficeStudioDocument
isOfficeStudioDocument(value: unknown): value is OfficeStudioDocument
Word: Tiptap/ProseMirror rich content, nested lists, tables and merges, embedded
PNG/JPEG insertion/resizing/alt text, default header/footer, PAGE/NUMPAGES fields,
current-region find/replace, heading outline, page setup and undo/redo. DOCX codecs
preserve supported images and single-section default headers/footers; floating or
external images, multi-section layouts, tracked changes, TOC and unknown fields are
rejected. The canvas has continuous content and explicit page breaks, not Office's
complete automatic pagination; native page fields are calculated by the DOCX reader.
Excel: cells, range selection, TSV clipboard with internal relative-formula
relocation, formatting, worksheet creation/rename/deletion, row/column insertion
and deletion, formulas, cross-sheet references, auto-sum, merging/splitting,
frozen rows/columns, single conditions per filter column, row sorting and native clustered column/standard line
charts. Limits: 10,000 rows/256 columns/32 sheets/100,000 stored cells; clipboard
10,000 cells, 500 structural edits per sheet before export/reimport. Structural
edits relocate absolute and relative A1/whole-row/whole-column references across
sheets; partial ranges shrink and deleted references become #REF!. Unsupported
dynamic, 3D and structured references fail atomically. Charts use a continuous
range with first-row series names and first-column categories. Pivot tables,
complex charts, images, protection, validation,
conditional formatting, named ranges and macros are rejected by the docs codec.
PDF: original page and thumbnail previews, zoom/rotation, extractable-text search
and result navigation, text/highlight/rectangle/freehand ink overlays, dragging,
undo/redo and ordinary AcroForm fields. Search requires session.search(query,
{signal}); results contain page, text and an original-PDF point rectangle.
PDF supports 1-200 pages; no arbitrary original text editing/reflow/OCR. Handwritten
signatures are vector ink, not certificate signatures. Encrypted files, XFA and
unsupported native fields are rejected rather than silently discarded.
The docs demo uses a separate zui-office-studio IndexedDB database with original
Blobs, revision-checked commits, coalesced saves and conflict copy recovery. It
keeps 20 prior committed versions per document; preview/export/print are read-only,
and restoration creates a new document. The local workspace limit is 100 documents.
Adapters: docs/src/pages/collaboration/office-studio/. UI: @zui/react/office-studio.
Codecs, PDF worker/fonts, print support and local history storage are host adapters,
not public UI-package exports or part of the CLI office-studio UI source item.
Editors and PDF rendering resources load on demand. Saving/exporting/printing/
getDocument commits focused editor input before reading a document snapshot.
Ctrl/Command S calls save; Ctrl/Command P calls onPrint when supplied. The docs
print adapter outputs current Word/Excel content or the exported PDF; browser
pagination can differ from Office, and Excel print regions above 50,000 cells fail
with an explicit export-XLSX suggestion.
Parts: root | header | title | actions | stage | loading | status | error
```

### CommandPalette (global command search, Modal + grouped listbox)
```
CommandPaletteCommand: { key; label; textValue?; group?; shortcut?; icon?; disabled?; keywords?; meta?; onSelect?(event) }
CommandPaletteSelectEvent: { command; query; source: 'keyboard' | 'pointer'; originalEvent; preventDefault(); defaultPrevented }
CommandPalette: (props: CommandPaletteProps) => JSX.Element
  commands: readonly CommandPaletteCommand[]                            // REQUIRED (deduped by key, first wins)
  open?/defaultOpen?/onOpenChange?(open, { reason: 'hotkey'|'escape'|'overlay'|'select', commandKey? })
  query?/defaultQuery?/onQueryChange?(query, { reason: 'input'|'close-reset' })
  resetQueryOnClose?: boolean                                           // default true, applies after actual close
  hotkey?: string | false                                               // default 'mod+k'; platform-aware mod; exact modifiers; false disables
  filter?: false | (command, query) => boolean                          // false = externally driven (async); default NFKC contains-match
  loading?/loadingContent?/emptyContent?
  onCommandSelect?: (command, event) => void                            // runs after command.onSelect; both observe preventDefault
  inputAriaLabel?/placeholder?/aria-label?/aria-labelledby?             // dialog AND input each have accessible names
  returnFocusRef?/restoreFocus?                                         // focus return on close (default true)
Reuses Modal (role=dialog + aria-modal + focus trap). Input role=combobox keeps
DOM focus; active option via aria-activedescendant; groups = role=group +
aria-labelledby; listbox aria-busy while loading. status (loading/empty/result
count) is a listbox SIBLING. Arrow keys move across groups (no wrap, no
Home/End hijack); Enter runs selection (IME-safe); Escape during composition
never closes. Shortcut kbd is display-only (dir=ltr, aria-hidden).
Parts: dialog | root | input | listbox | group | group-label | option | option-icon | option-label | option-shortcut | status
```
### Modal (compound)
```
Modal: (props: ModalProps) => JSX.Element
  open?: boolean
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  children: React.ReactNode                                            // REQUIRED
Modal.Trigger: native button, toggles open on click, props forwarded
Modal.Content: (props: ModalContentProps) => JSX.Element
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'                                            // default 'md'
  closeOnOverlay?: boolean                                             // default true
  closeOnEsc?: boolean                                                 // default true
  classNames?: { overlay?: string; content?: string }
  ...rest: React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>
Modal.Header | Modal.Title | Modal.Description | Modal.Body | Modal.Footer: structure components (Title/Description auto-wire aria-labelledby/aria-describedby)
Modal.Close: native button; icon-only use defaults to aria-label="关闭", text children provide the accessible name and render as an action button
Content renders via Portal to body; root dialog: role="dialog", aria-modal="true", tabIndex=-1
Focus (APG): open moves focus ([data-autofocus] first, else first focusable, else dialog), Tab cycles, close restores focus to trigger
Also: overlay click close, Esc close, scroll lock, data-state="open"/"closed" enter/exit animation
Parts (inside Content): trigger | overlay | content | header | title | description | body | footer | close
```

### Tabs (compound)
```
Tabs: (props: TabsProps) => JSX.Element
  value?: string
  defaultValue?: string
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void                              // NOTE: name is onValueChange
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'                              // default 'horizontal'
  activationMode?: 'automatic' | 'manual'                              // default 'automatic' (focus selects); manual = Enter/Space
  children?: React.ReactNode
  className?: string
  classNames?: { root?: string; list?: string; trigger?: string; panel?: string }
Tabs.List: role="tablist" + aria-orientation
Tabs.Trigger: { value: string; disabled?: boolean; icon?: React.ReactNode } + forwarded props; role="tab"; roving tabindex (selected=0, others=-1)
Tabs.Panel: { value: string; forceMount?: boolean }                    // default unmounted when inactive; forceMount keeps it (hidden)
Keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (ArrowUp/ArrowDown when vertical), Home/End; manual mode activates on Enter/Space
aria-controls / aria-labelledby wired both ways via useId
Parts: root | list | trigger | panel | icon
```

### Table (compound, presentational)
```
Table: (props: TableProps) => JSX.Element
  density?: 'comfortable' | 'compact'                                  // default 'comfortable' (root data-density)
  bordered?: boolean                                                   // default false (row separators always on)
  striped?: boolean                                                    // default false
  classNames?: { root?: string }
  ...rest: React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'table'>                        // except 'size'
Table.Head | Table.Body: thead / tbody wrappers, props forwarded
Table.Row: { selected?: boolean } → data-selected; class z-table-row
Table.HeaderCell: { align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right' } (default 'left'); th with scope="col"
Table.Cell: { align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right' } (default 'left'); data-align
Pure semantic table markup: <table>/<thead>/<tbody>/<tr>/<th>/<td>
Parts: root | header-cell | cell
```

### Message (hooks-based — NO static methods)
```
MessageProvider: (props) => JSX.Element
  children?: React.ReactNode
  max?: number                                                         // default 3 (oldest evicted)
  placement?: 'top' | 'bottom'                                         // default 'top' (list data-placement)
useMessage(): MessageApi                                               // THROWS outside MessageProvider
MessageApi:
  show:    (config: MessageConfig | string) => string                  // returns id
  success: (config: MessageConfig | string) => string
  error:   (config: MessageConfig | string) => string
  warning: (config: MessageConfig | string) => string
  info:    (config: MessageConfig | string) => string
  dismiss: (id: string) => void
  clear:   () => void
MessageConfig:
  content: React.ReactNode                                             // REQUIRED
  duration?: number                                                    // default 3000 ms; 0 = never auto-close
  closable?: boolean                                                   // default false (close button aria-label="关闭")
  onClose?: () => void
Semantics: role="status" + aria-live="polite" (error: aria-live="assertive"); data-variant per type; data-state="open"/"closing" (200ms exit)
NEVER write message.success() as a global/static call — always useMessage() inside MessageProvider.
Parts: root (z-message-list) | item | icon | content | close
```

## Controlled-State Convention

- Object/string state: `value` + `onChange(next)`; uncontrolled via `defaultValue`.
- Boolean state (Checkbox/Switch): `checked` + `onChange(checked: boolean)`; uncontrolled via `defaultChecked`.
- Open state (Modal): `open` + `onOpenChange(open: boolean)`; uncontrolled via `defaultOpen`.
- Tabs: `value` + `onValueChange(value: string)`.
- Select/RadioGroup: `value` + `onChange(value: string)`.

## Customization Outlets (the ONLY supported styling hooks)

Every component exposes exactly three semantic outlets:

1. `data-part="<part>"` on each structural element (root is `data-part="root"`); states via data attributes (`data-variant`, `data-size`, `data-status`, `data-open`, `data-selected`, `data-checked`...).
2. `classNames?: Record<PartName, string>` — slot-level class names APPENDED (never overriding) to each part.
3. Component-level CSS variables `--z-<component>-*` (e.g. `--z-button-bg`, `--z-input-height`, `--z-modal-content-radius`) defined on the component's own selector; override anywhere.

Global design tokens (override to re-theme): `--z-color-{bg,fg,border,primary,danger,success,warning,info,...}` semantic layer, `--z-radius` (single source; sm/md/lg/xl derive via calc), `--z-space-1..12`, `--z-text-xs..2xl`, `--z-shadow-xs..lg`, `--z-font-sans/mono`, `--z-duration-*`, `--z-z-*` (z-index scale).

Example re-theme:
```css
:root { --z-color-primary: hsl(220 62% 46%); --z-radius: 10px; }
.z-button-slot { --z-button-radius: 2px; } /* component-scoped override */
```

## Taboos (do NOT do these)

- Do NOT style via internal class names (`z-button`, `z-input-field`, ...) — they are implementation details and not part of the contract. Use `data-part`, `classNames`, and `--z-<component>-*` variables only.
- Do NOT use static/imperative message APIs (e.g. `message.success(...)` imported from the package) — use `useMessage()` inside `MessageProvider`.
- Do NOT use `forwardRef` — React 19 native `ref` prop.
- Do NOT rely on state modifier classes (no `.is-active`) — states are data attributes.
- Do NOT hardcode colors in overrides that should theme — override semantic `--z-color-*` tokens instead.
- Do NOT expect `Select` to accept arbitrary DOM props (it takes a fixed prop set + aria-*); wrap it for layout (no `style` prop).
- Do NOT skip keyboard/ARIA requirements when composing: focus visibility (`:focus-visible`), roles and `aria-*` are contractual.

## AI Auto-Translate (useAutoTranslate) — @zui/i18n

Automatic translation of built-in component copy (placeholder / 请选择 / 清除 / 关闭 /
暂无数据 / 上一页 / 下一页 …) via OpenAI / DeepL / Youdao / custom endpoints, with a
localStorage cache and graceful fallback to the source text on errors.

```
import { useAutoTranslate, type TranslateConfig, type TranslateProvider } from '@zui/i18n';

type TranslateProvider = 'openai' | 'deepl' | 'youdao' | 'custom';

interface TranslateConfig {
  provider: TranslateProvider;
  baseURL?: string;                // OpenAI-compatible API root; host-only gets /v1
  key?: string;                    // OpenAI-compatible Bearer key
  apiKey?: string;                 // youdao: appKey
  endpoint?: string;               // REQUIRED for 'custom'; full URL override for others
  model?: string;                  // openai, e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini'
  appSecret?: string;              // youdao signing secret
  sourceLang?: string;             // default 'zh'
  targetLang: string;              // REQUIRED, e.g. 'en'
  cache?: boolean;                 // default true (localStorage)
  cacheKey?: string;               // default 'zui-translate-cache'
}

function useAutoTranslate(config: TranslateConfig): {
  t:      (text: string, context?: { component?: string; role?: string }) => Promise<string>;
  tSync:  (text: string, context?: { component?: string; role?: string }) => string;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error?: Error;
  clearCache: () => void;
};
```

- `t(text, context)` — async translate; cache hit resolves immediately; provider failure
  falls back to the source text (never throws into render).
- `tSync(text, context)` — render-safe: cache hit returns the translation synchronously;
  miss returns the source text and schedules an async backfill (re-render picks it up).
- `context` injects component hints into the provider prompt
  (`t('请选择', { component: 'Select', role: 'placeholder' })`).
- Cache: `localStorage`, keyed by language pair, provider settings, source text and component/role context. `clearCache()` empties it.
- OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions setup: `baseURL`, `key`, `model` plus `targetLang`.
  A host-only baseURL gets `/v1/chat/completions`; versioned or proxy paths get
  `/chat/completions`. A server proxy can keep the key.
- Provider endpoints: openai `chat/completions` (system prompt carries component context),
  deepl `/v2/translate`, youdao `/api`, custom `POST endpoint`
  `{ texts, sourceLang, targetLang, contexts? }` → `{ translations: string[] }`.
- Translations with missing, renamed or extra `{placeholder}` variables fall back to source text.
- ConfigProvider accepts `translate?: TranslateConfig` and translates built-in copy at runtime.
  Nested providers merge source locales before translating; application children and values are not translated.
  A key or proxy endpoint enables OpenAI/DeepL, Youdao needs appKey + appSecret, and custom needs an endpoint.

## meta.json — per-component AI metadata (CONTRACTS-V3 §2)

Path: `packages/ui/src/components/<Name>/meta.json` (all 73 source Registry components ship metadata). Consumed by `@zui/mcp` tools
and the registry generator.

```json
{
  "name": "Button",
  "description": "按钮组件，触发即时操作",
  "category": "基础",
  "useCase": ["表单提交", "对话框确认", "工具栏操作"],
  "dontUse": ["不要用 Button 做页面导航（用 Link）"],
  "props": {
    "variant": { "type": "'primary'|'secondary'|'outline'|'ghost'|'danger'", "default": "'primary'", "desc": "按钮变体" }
  },
  "a11yNotes": ["loading 时保持可聚焦"],
  "related": ["Input", "Form"]
}
```

Field meaning:
- `name` / `description` — component name and one-line summary (used in search results).
- `category` — one of 基础 / 数据录入 / 数据展示 / 导航 / 反馈 / 表单 / 其他.
- `useCase` — when TO use this component (array of short phrases).
- `dontUse` — when NOT to (and which component to use instead).
- `props` — only the KEY props (4–8 per component), each `{ type, default?, desc }`.
- `a11yNotes` — accessibility contract (roles, aria, keyboard).
- `related` — related component names.

## Registry & CLI (packages/cli + registry/)

The registry (`registry/registry.json`) contains 73 source components and 16 blocks, generated from sources +
`meta.json`; `@zui/cli` copies component source into your project (free to edit) with an
upstream update channel.

```bash
node registry/scripts/generate.mjs          # rebuild registry.json
node registry/scripts/generate.mjs --check  # CI: registry vs components

pnpm dlx @yeyouyuan/zui-cli@0.4.0 init                 # interactive setup → writes .zurc.json
pnpm dlx @yeyouyuan/zui-cli@0.4.0 add button           # copy Button.tsx + Button.css → src/components/ui/button/
pnpm dlx @yeyouyuan/zui-cli@0.4.0 add button modal     # multiple components
pnpm dlx @yeyouyuan/zui-cli@0.4.0 add --all            # everything in the registry
pnpm dlx @yeyouyuan/zui-cli@0.4.0 diff button          # unified diff: local copy vs registry (update channel)
pnpm dlx @yeyouyuan/zui-cli@0.4.0 list                 # list all components (--json for machine output)
```

- `add` copies components to `<components>/<kebab-name>/`, blocks to `<components>/blocks/<name>/`,
  shared utils/config/styles to `<components>/_zui/`, resolves `registryDependencies` recursively,
  rewrites imports and prints npm deps. Registry top-level `exports` maps public symbols to barrels.
- Published CLI/MCP packages include their registry, source and metadata in `data/`.
- `diff` outputs `--- a/... +++ b/...` patches (local = a, registry = b).
- registry entry shape: `{ name, type: 'registry:component' | 'registry:block', title, description,
  dependencies, registryDependencies, files, cssVars, meta }` — `meta` points at the
  component's `meta.json`.

## MCP server (packages/mcp) — 3 tools

`@zui/mcp` is a pure stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 server (no MCP SDK). Configure it in Claude
Desktop / Cursor as a stdio MCP server (see `packages/mcp/README.md` for full config):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "zui": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/abs/path/to/zui/packages/mcp/dist/index.js"],
      "env": { "ZUI_ROOT": "/abs/path/to/zui" }
    }
  }
}
```

Tools (via `tools/call`):

| tool | args | returns |
|---|---|---|
| `zui_search_components` | `query` (string, required), `limit` (number) | `{ query, count, results: [{ name, description, category }] }` |
| `zui_get_component_api` | `name` (string, required) | markdown props signature + usage + a11y (from meta.json + CONTRACTS-V3) |
| `zui_generate_code` | `component` (string, required), `props` (object), `children` (string) | import + usable JSX snippet; `props` values render literally, `"{expr}"` emits a JSX expression |

Example request line (one JSON per line on stdin):

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"zui_search_components","arguments":{"query":"表单"}}}
```

Raw JSON-RPC methods supported: `initialize`, `notifications/initialized`, `ping`,
`tools/list`, `tools/call`.

## Design Assets (设计资源) — docs DesignAssetsPage

Design-token source of truth: `packages/tokens/src/tokens.json` (DTCG format;
`$type` / `$value`; the semantic layer's `$value` is ALWAYS an alias chain like
`{zui.primitives.brand.600}`, never a bare color). CSS layering:
`base.css` (primitives `--z-neutral-*`, `--z-brand-*`, ...) → `semantic.css`
(`--z-color-*`, light values) → `dark.css` (remaps ONLY `--z-color-*` under
`[data-theme='dark']` + a `prefers-color-scheme` fallback; dimension tokens are
never remapped). Contrast is WCAG AA calibrated in both themes.

- Figma: open Tokens Studio for Figma → Settings → Load from file → paste
  `tokens.json` → two token sets import automatically (primitives + semantic).
  Bind component styles to the SEMANTIC layer only.
- Three token layers: primitive (`zui.primitives.brand.600` ↔ `--z-brand-600`,
  the only place raw values live) → semantic (`zui.semantic.color.primary` ↔
  `--z-color-primary`, the only layer components consume) → component-level
  (`--z-<name>-*`, e.g. `--z-button-bg`, runtime-derived from semantic).
- Re-branding (3 steps, semantic layer ONLY):
  1) create `brand-skin.css` overriding semantic `--z-color-*` vars, values must
     reference primitive scales (e.g. `--z-color-primary: var(--z-success-600)`,
     hover 700, active 800, subtle 50/700, link/focus 600);
  2) import after `@zui/react/styles.css` and mount the class on a container or
     `:root`; `ConfigProvider` (locale/translate) is orthogonal to theming;
  3) add dark values under `[data-theme='dark'] .brand-spring` mirroring
     dark.css rules (600→500, fg inverted, subtle 900/300) plus a
     `:root:not([data-theme='light'])` media fallback.
- CDN (no-build): `pnpm --filter @zui/react build:browser` →
  `packages/ui/dist/browser/zui.global.js` + `zui.css` (+ LICENSE.txt), synced
  to `docs/dist/cdn/v<v>/` (version from package.json, currently v0.4.0).
  Public Pages serves `cdn/v0.4.0/` and the matching demo page after deployment.
  Usage: `<link rel="stylesheet" href="cdn/v0.4.0/zui.css">` +
  `<script src="cdn/v0.4.0/zui.global.js">`; the IIFE bundles React 19 under
  the global namespace `ZUI` (`ZUI.React`, `ZUI.createRoot`, `ZUI.hydrateRoot`,
  every component). Live example: `/cdn-demo.html`.
- Naming map (Figma path ↔ CSS variable): `zui.primitives.brand.600` ↔
  `--z-brand-600`; `zui.semantic.color.primary` ↔ `--z-color-primary`;
  `zui.semantic.radius.lg` ↔ `--z-radius-lg` (single source `--z-radius`,
  sm/md/lg/xl derive via calc); `zui.semantic.shadow.md` ↔ `--z-shadow-md`;
  `zui.semantic.font.sans` ↔ `--z-font-sans`. Dimension tokens (`--z-radius`,
  `--z-space-1..12`, `--z-text-xs..2xl`, `--z-shadow-xs..lg`, `--z-duration-*`,
  `--z-z-*`) are theme-agnostic. Semantic color matrix (light/dark, per
  semantic.css/dark.css): bg 50/950, bg-subtle 100/900, bg-muted 200/800,
  bg-elevated 50/900, bg-inverse 900/50; fg 950/50, fg-muted 600/300,
  fg-subtle 500/400, fg-inverse 50/950, fg-on-primary 50/950; border 300/700,
  border-subtle 200/800, border-strong 500/400, border-focus brand 600/500;
  primary brand 600/500 (+hover 700/400, active 800/300, fg neutral 50/950,
  subtle brand 50/900, subtle-fg brand 700/300); `{danger,success,warning,info}`
  600/500 (+hover 700/400, fg neutral 50/950, subtle {role} 50/900, subtle-fg
  {role} 700/300); link brand 600/500, link-hover brand 700/400, focus-ring
  brand 600/500; overlay neutral-950 @45%/65% (color-mix), disabled-bg 100/800,
  disabled-fg 400/500, disabled-border 200/800.
